name: DesertDown Dev Container
postCreateCommand: rustup component add rustfmt clippy && sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo/registry /usr/local/cargo/git /fuzz-out && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /usr/local/cargo/registry /usr/local/cargo/git /fuzz-out
initializeCommand: docker run --rm --privileged alpine sh -c 'echo core > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern' || true
